notes: v3.0.28 — Fixes the refusal that blocked chart history for most patients. athenaOne draws every appointment twice (a main schedule and a mini schedule), so looking a patient up by their appointment id found several matching elements and MLS refused the read as ambiguous - even though they were all the same appointment. Duplicate copies are now recognised as one appointment and the fuller main-grid row is used. Identity is still proven from the chart banner, exactly as before. Requires Chrome 116+.
